workflowRecommendation: Single implementer, then tester, reviewer, retro, merger on one branch. No child issues. Docs-only pull request: no Thermo pass; no formatters, linters, or test suites exist in this repository. Architect ruling 12:35Z: pull request #31 is this issue's pull request (do not close it). A child issue LEGSMOKE-2 (one appended README line, its own branch legion/LEGSMOKE-2 and pull request) exists; the root tester runs only after the root implementer completes AND LEGSMOKE-2 closes. That child's README line and this issue's new smoke/ file cannot conflict, so no rebase is expected when main moves; rebase only if GitHub reports #31 CONFLICTING.
concerns: Pull request #31 (https://github.com/sjawhar/legion-smoke/pull/31, 'smoke: LEGSMOKE-1 green-merge probe 20260913T051559Z', opened by app/legion-implementer in an earlier probe of this same issue key) is OPEN on head branch legion/LEGSMOKE-1 at 5e110547fb50947fec7a06e087cfb7a9915a2436. Because the branch name is mandated, every push to legion/LEGSMOKE-1 updates #31; `gh pr create` will fail with 'a pull request for branch legion/LEGSMOKE-1 already exists'. Decision: reuse #31 as this issue's pull request (the daemon binds it to LEGSMOKE-1 on the first `synchronize`, reducers.ts registerPrFenced). The implementer rewrites its title and body with `gh pr edit 31`; it never closes #31 or opens a second PR.

The planner's handoff push is the first push to legion/LEGSMOKE-1 and moves #31's head sideways from 5e110547 to the plan handoff commit (force-with-lease by jj). The superseded head is an agent-created throwaway probe; the planner records its SHA in a comment on #31 so the content stays addressable.

The provisioned workspace snapshots an empty, untracked-by-intent file `.omp/config.yml` into the working-copy commit (no .gitignore exists in this repository and snapshot.auto-track=all()). It MUST NOT reach the branch. Verified on jj 0.45.1 in this workspace: `jj split -m <msg> <paths>` puts the selected paths in a described parent and MOVES THE BOOKMARK onto the undescribed remainder child that still carries `.omp/config.yml`. Therefore every phase: commits only with `jj split -m <msg> <exact paths>` (never `jj new` on top of the working copy, never `jj commit`); immediately afterwards runs `jj bookmark set legion/LEGSMOKE-1 -r @- --allow-backwards` (backwards because the bookmark is on the child); and checks `jj file list -r legion/LEGSMOKE-1 | sed -n '/^\.omp\//p'` prints nothing before every push. The planner hit exactly this and caught it with that check. This is a Legion tooling finding for sjawhar/legion (workspace provisioning should exclude `.omp/`), not something to fix in sjawhar/legion-smoke.

Acceptance line 1 ('changed-files list names only that path') is literally true only at the final head after the implementer's `.legion/` deletion push. While `.legion/*.json` handoffs ride the branch, the tester and reviewer evaluate the check with `.legion/` excluded and re-confirm it literally at the `.legion/`-free head the reviewer approves.

Content follows the five existing markers byte-for-byte in shape: one line, NO trailing newline (all five legion16-green files are exactly their sentence with no newline). git shows '\ No newline at end of file'; the diff still counts as exactly one added line. Byte count 78, sha256 bd0395f8ecb77ff6617283f4bd2f0a5fcc29b1f7ec2c2bce1b3850777a4fb584.

implement: legion-worker: the only source for the branch name, split/bookmark/push procedure, PR body READY format, `Dispatch: LEGSMOKE-1` line, Legion comment footer, and the `.legion/implement.json` completion gate; this repository has no AGENTS.md or skills of its own.

verification-before-completion: the marker's bytes (wc -c = 78, sha256 match), the branch tree (no .omp/, no .fail-me), and the PR head SHA must be shown by command output before the phase is reported complete.
test: legion-worker: defines the E2E section the tester fills (surface, exact command, observation, head SHA, one negative control) and the rule that a unit test is never proof of a criterion; also the `.legion/test.json` gate and the -r @- bookmark discipline this plan adds.

verification-before-completion: every acceptance claim (files list, both workflow conclusions, no .fail-me) is asserted only with the command output at the named head SHA pasted into the PR body's E2E line.
review: legion-worker: one review per round through the pulls/{n}/reviews API with commit_id and the Legion footer; docs-only PR so the Thermo line is omitted entirely; APPROVE only the `.legion/`-free head named by SHA; CI/Threads/E2E facts verified against GitHub, never from a handoff.
verification-before-completion: the reviewer re-runs the three acceptance commands itself at the head it approves rather than trusting the tester's paste.
